summary: A Polygon guide to the act 2 quest chain in Baldur's Gate 3 that wakes Art Cullagh, rescues Thaniel, and recruits Halsin as a companion. It walks through retrieving a Battered Lute from Malus Thorm, defending a portal against undead, and reuniting Thaniel with Oliver. Thaniel alone cannot end the Shadow Curse; the main quest in Moonrise Towers must still be finished.
one_line: Guide to waking Art Cullagh, rescuing Thaniel, reuniting him with Oliver and recruiting Halsin in Baldur's Gate 3 act 2.
key_facts: Art Cullagh is a sleepy man in the Last Light Inn in act 2 of Baldur's Gate 3 and is key to breaking the Shadow Curse.
Halsin, at camp, tells the player about Thaniel, a Tiefling who is the root of the curse over the Shadow-cursed Land.
Art Cullagh lies in the bunks on the first floor of the Last Light Inn, just right of the entrance; he needs a personal item to wake up.
Reading Art's last orders letter, with Halsin's help, makes a quest marker appear near Moonrise Towers.
Malus Thorm is an undead boss and 'surgeon' found in the large back room of the House of Healing, near the Road to Baldur's Gate Waypoint.
Killing Malus Thorm and his assistants lets the player loot a Battered Lute from his body.
Playing the Battered Lute for Art wakes him, even if the character is not proficient in an instrument.
Halsin goes into a portal alone while the player defends it against a massive undead army for multiple rounds of combat.
The article recommends Shadowheart, who can use Turn Undead, and Gale, whose AoE abilities like Fireball clear low-health enemies.
After the portal defense, Halsin returns carrying Thaniel's body and offers to join the party at camp.
Oliver, Thaniel's other half, lives in a house east of Last Light in an area called 'House in Deep Shadows' and plays hide-and-seek.
Oliver teleports the player to the Moonrise Towers town square with resurrected Mommy and Daddy Shades and encases himself in a shield that takes damage whenever one of his minions is killed.
Persuading or threatening Oliver makes him rejoin Thaniel, but ending the curse still requires finishing the mainline quest in Moonrise Towers.
